A FAIROZ

Mobile: +91 9187448373 | Email: fairoza928@gmail.com

Career Appointments

Worked as a Technical Lead for HCL Tech, Bangalore since June-2025 to Sep 2025.

Worked as a Software Engineer for Feat Innovations Private Limited, Mumbai since May-2019 to May 2025.

Academic Credentials B.E(EEE) from Visvesvaraya Technological University, KA, 2015

Technical Arsenal

lava Language:

Strong understanding of Java programming and object-oriented concepts.

Spring Boot Framework:

Proficient in using Spring Boot to create RESTful APIs and scalable backend applications, Knowledge of Spring Boot

features such as dependency injection and configuration management.

Database Management:

Experience with JPA (Java Persistence API) for database interactions and familiarity with Hibernate for object-

relational mapping (ORM).

API Development:

I am skilled in designing and developing RESTful APIs for seamless data exchange between client and server.

HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript:

Proficient understanding of web markup, including HTML5 and CSS3 for frontend presentation.

Familiarity with basic JavaScript for frontend interactions and API consumption.

Development Methodologies:

Understanding of Agile methodologies to promote iterative development and collaboration.

Cross-Browser Compatibility:

Knowledge of cross-browser compatibility issues and ways to resolve them when developing web applications.

Cloud Services:

Developed and deployed Java-based applications on AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) and Azure (App Service, Azure SQL,

Blob Storage), ensuring high availability and seamless cloud integration.

A Fairoz | Document layout robustness test

Engagement Portfolio

#1 Project name: SPICE JET

Description:

Spice Jet is an Indian low-cost airline headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana. It is the

The second largest airline in the country carried by number of domestic passengers, with a market share of 13.6% as

of March 2019. The airline operates 630 daily flights to 64 destinations, including 54 Indian and 15 international

destinations from its hubs at Delhi and Hyderabad.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Gathered and analyzed requirements from functional teams and clients for backend development.

Understood user stories and analyzed the technical tasks assigned for backend services.

Participated in daily stand-up calls to provide updates on project progress and tasks.

Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Java Spring Boot for web applications.

Analyzed requirements to design database schemas and suggest architectural changes.

Worked with common Java development tools such as Maven for project management.

Consumed and integrated external RESTful APIs as per project requirements.

Implemented functionalities based on requirements provided by clients daily.

Worked with Spring Boot features such as dependency injection and security to enhance API functionality.

Developed and maintained responsive, high-performance web applications using ReactJs , Javascript, HTML5, and

SCSS.

Designed dynamic and reusable UI components using ReactJs.

Implemented component-based architecture ensuring scalability and reusability across the application.

Utilized HTTP libraries for handling requests and responses within the application.

Managed application state, configuration, and transactions to ensure data integrity and performance.

Technologies and Tools: Core Java, Java 11, Spring, Spring Boot, REST API, Hibernate, JPA, Microservices, AWS, S3

Bucket

#2 Project name: Health Care

Description:

Fortis Healthcare Limited – an IHH Healthcare Bread Company – is a leading integrated health care services provider

in India. It is one of the largest healthcare organizations in the country with 36 healthcare facilities (including projects

under development), 4000 operational beds and over 400 diagnostics centers (including JVs). Fortis is present in India,

United Arab Emirates (UAE) & Sri Lanka. Fortis offers a full spectrum of integrated healthcare services ranging from

clinics to quaternary care facilities and a wide range of ancillary services.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Responsible for creating efficient design and developing backend services using Core Java, Java 8, and Spring

framework.

Designed and developed responsive, modular Angular components for patient dashboards, doctor portals, and admin

interfaces.

Proficient in Spring Boot for developing RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.

Experienced in implementing data persistence using Hibernate and JPA for effective database management.

A Fairoz | Document layout robustness test

Skilled in developing and consuming REST APIs as per project requirements.

Familiar with cloud services, particularly AWS and using S3 Bucket for storage solutions.

Worked in environments utilizing microservices to create scalable and modular applications.

Managed state and data flow across modules using RxJS Observables, Services, and NgRx Store.

Implemented lazy loading and AOT compilation to improve app performance and reduce load times.

Technologies and Tools: Core Java, Java 8, Spring, Spring Boot, REST API, Hibernate, JPA, Microservices, AWS, HTML,

CSS, JavaScript, React, MySQL

#Project Name : Resource Planning Clients: Tools & Technology: Java 1.8, Spring boot, JPA, Micro services, RESTful webservices, JUnit, Mockito, Eclipse, Kafka,

Docker, Kubernetes Description RP project is for managing administrative operations of an organization.

The Objective of this product is to Generate Reports like Purchase Order, Sales Order and Invoice Statement etc. This

product is also useful for managing Asset, Employee Details and Staff Payroll Processing.

It is an internet-based product and the Users for this application are Accountant, Managing Director of an

Organization. Responsibilities:

Implementing rest API using spring boot

Micro services using spring cloud

Performed Client-Side validations at Screen level as per requirement.

Implemented Hibernate in persistence layer as ORM tool to interact with databases.

Involved in analyzing & fixing defects & implementing Enhancements logged by client.

Implemented Log4J logging for logging messages in various screens and debugging.

Professional Bummary 6+ years of Hands-on experience in Java Full stack developing robust backend applications using Java (versions 8 and

11).

Proficient in Spring Boot for creating RESTful services and scalable web applications.

Knowledge of JPA (Java Persistence API) for managing database integrations.

Experience with Hibernate for object-relational mapping (ORM).

Designed and developed scalable microservices solutions using Spring Boot, enabling modular deployment and

improving platform reliability.

Proficient in designing User Interface (UI) web applications using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (including ES6+

features).

Familiar with ReactJS for frontend development and creating dynamic Single Page Applications (SPAs).

Experience with state management libraries like Redux and implementing routing in React applications using react-

router-dom.

Familiar with common front-end development tools such as Webpack, Babel, and NPM.

Experience in consuming and building RESTful APIs for seamless data exchange.

Developed and deployed Java-based applications on AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) and Azure (App Service, Azure SQL,

Blob Storage), ensuring high availability and seamless cloud integration.

Hands on experience in the Database oracle, SQL Server, Postgres

Proficient in using HTTP libraries such as Axios for handling asynchronous requests.

A Fairoz | Document layout robustness test

Experienced in using Visual Studio Code and other IDE tools for application development.

Strong knowledge of version control systems, including GIT and GitHub, for effective source code management.

Familiar with Agile development practices, promoting iterative development and cross-functional teamwork.

Demonstrated ability to learn continuously and adopt new technologies.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Career Objective Working in a challenging environment provides an opportunity for me to undergo continuous learning and keep

myself competitive with the changing scenario of the world, which intends to contribute positively to the growth and

prosperity of the organization. I am a motivated individual with in-depth knowledge of languages and development

tools, seeking a position in a growth-oriented company where I can use my skills to the advantage of the company

while having the scope to develop my own skills.
